title: A gate whose question names a forge only inside a host name (docs.gitlab.com) is not classed push
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons does not class a gate push for a forge word that is part of a host name in its question or options, so a query-log or source question about a documentation host stays answerable by the delegate

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;c=a.derived_class({'touches':['kb/_querylog/findings/**']},{'id':'g2','question':'How are the four route findings (docs.gitlab.com, learn.microsoft.com) closed?','options':['hand-written records','leave them open']});print(c);sys.exit(1 if c=='push' else 0)

notes: Another trigger, 2026-10-23 (ST-y627kmds gate g1): a design question that names 'the gitlab closings' (gap-note closings about GitLab articles, no push action) was classed push by the word gitlab and made blocking.
